chapter: Henderson, Lester and the bands breaking up
title: The territory bands break up; Fletcher Henderson's Kansas City audition
summary: With the bands breaking up, Henderson hears Ben, Herschel and Lester in Kansas City to replace Hawkins.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Then after that band broke up -- see, I worked with Troy for a short while -- they broke up, too.
Alfonso Trent, all of them broke up at the same time.
Times were getting kind of hard with bands even then and really, I don't -- they weren't that hard

though. I don't really see why -- then Bennie Moten was scuffling because -- as big as he was namewise. That's when Basie took his band over, you see? Coleman Hawkins was -- had been hired from Jack Hilton to come to London to join his band. So, well, Fletcher's looking for some saxophone players to join his band. So in Kansas City, they had a cutting --play--- one night. I was in Little Rock. Ben, Herschel and Lester. After Fletcher finished the dance that night, they were playing the Cherry Blossom, they got Hawk down there and Fletcher came, he wanted to listen to all three of them to see which one he wanted, you know.

He's going to leave and go to London. And so they get him down there that night and they tell me all three of them wiped him away. I didn't hear it, you know. They said he couldn't get straight, said he drank a quart of whiskey, right on the bandstand, trying to -- said he just -- reeds didn't work right. Just wasn't his night.
And they says all of them washed him away and says Prez washed everybody away with "Ideas" and things.
